SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE status = 5 AND pay_status = 1 AND pay_time >= #{date} AND pay_time < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 5 AND pay_status = 1 AND pay_time >= #{date} AND pay_time < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
